text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I've been waiting for you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you look a bit refreshed. Seems like 
you got a good night's rest too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Which means... it seems we've both 
recovered plenty from our fatigue.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Taking the day off was well worth 
the effort! Splendid decision!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I laid the praise on a bit too 
thick. Still, everyone needs some words of 
appreciation now and then, fufu.

It seems she was trying to... compliment 
my schedule management skills. I'll gladly 
accept the thought.
